newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were weaker in after-hours trade on Wednesday on constant selling with no bullish factors in sight, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 0.5 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Most-active benchmark June was off 0.2 yen at 145.9 yen. Volume was 4,448 lots.

A recovery of weather in rubber producing countries, and the yen's firmer tendency, along with views that falls in Japan rubber stocks will be limited for the near-term, were cited as negative factors in the market, traders said.
